newsitem.title: BELGIUM: BELGIAN SHARES END STRONG, IGNORE HESITANT DOW.
newsitem.headline: BELGIAN SHARES END STRONG, IGNORE HESITANT DOW.

text.p: 1430 GMT - Bel-20 index ignores hesitant opening on Wall Street to end near intra-day high.
* Stock market supported by firm debt, which in turn underpinned by Bundesbank decision to leave rates unchanged.
* Bel-20 ends 0.64 percent, or 13.74 points, higher at 2,147.34 in 2,133-2,150 range. Three billion francs worth of Belgian shares traded.
* Insurer Fortis AG main gainer, up 2.7 percent at 6,000 francs.
